newsitem.title: USA: Ford exec sees rise in US truck market share.
newsitem.headline: Ford exec sees rise in US truck market share.

text.p: Ross Roberts, Ford Motor Co vice president and general manager of its Ford Division, said he expected Ford to increase its share of the U.S. truck market in 1997 and hold its car share steady.
Roberts was speaking to reporters at the Chicago Auto Show.

Ford's share of the combined car and light truck market dipped slightly to 25.4 percent from 25.8 percent in 1995. Ford Division's car share fell half a percentage point in 1996, while Ford's share of a growing truck market increased a third of a percentage point.

Ford also introduced "Special Vehicle Team" (SVT) high-performance versions of its Contour sedan and Ranger compact pickup truck. The vehicles will be sold in limited annual volumes of about 5,000 to 10,000 each, a Ford spokesman said.
